dlg.hesk.app_abandoned: (Reads the notes you hand over, slowly.) So… he did not come back. (Silence.) Thank you for bringing his notes. Better that than doubt. (Closes the notebook.) There is something I will not tell you: what I think of leaving someone behind. But the forge stays open for you.
dlg.hesk.app_active: Any word of Tarn? The Quarry is big and the underground bigger. Check the camps: he always scratches a compass into his marks.
dlg.hesk.app_offer: (Takes off her gloves.) …There is a job. Not one that pays well. My apprentice, Tarn, left weeks ago for the Quarry with six others to “map the underground”. Only his compass came back, this morning, at the door. (Holds it out.) If you could look… I cannot close the forge.
dlg.hesk.app_rescued: (Hesk is speechless. Then, loudly:) He is ALIVE?! …(Sighs, wipes her face with her apron.) I owe you more than I can pay. Lifelong discount — and do not argue — and this, which I was saving for a good day.
dlg.hesk.first_1: (Without looking up from a dismantled resonator.) A customer. How rare. I am Hesk, of the Tuners' Guild: I buy what I salvage, sell what is left, and tune what lets itself be tuned. This forge tunes gear, not people. That is what Sil is for.
dlg.hesk.guild: We Tuners salvage Serrane technology. Neutral by trade: we sell the Watch pegs; the Taciturn, silence. (Smiles.) They almost always pay.
dlg.hesk.hub.c3: Looking for someone to do you a favour?
dlg.maeve.bells: How are those bells coming along? Remember: the tablets are scattered — Orrel's hall, the harps and the overlook. You put the sentences together; the bells will ring on their own.
dlg.maeve.first_1: Oh, look at that hungry face! (Stirs a pot.) I am Maeve. Here we eat what there is and tell what we hear. Soup or gossip?
dlg.maeve.rumor1: They say the bells on the Path ring by themselves at nightfall, though they have no clapper. My cousin heard them… or dreamt them. The tablets that speak of them are scattered all over the valley, as if someone hid them on purpose!
dlg.maeve.rumor2: That the wind in the harps, when it rages, brings out flowers that only bloom in a storm. My bellflower soup begs for them.
dlg.maeve.rumor3: That the quarry quartz “sings” if you stand still and listen. I did not try: I have enough with what is on the stove.
dlg.maeve.rumor4: That up at the overlook there is a cylinder repeating a sad song. A woman, I think. I could never sit through the whole thing.
dlg.maeve.rumor5: That if you see a mouthless statue, look at it well. Something looks back. Or not. My aunt took to praying to them.
dlg.maeve.rumor_end: I have told you everything I know… and some I do not. If you want more, ask again: I will remember other things.
dlg.orrel.confront: (A long silence.) Yes. I know. I watched them rewrite the books, years ago. I kept quiet for the village: without the promise that the Choir will return, no one stays here. Do with that what you must.
dlg.orrel.confront.c0: I understand. Thank you for saying it.
dlg.orrel.crypt_1: The Resonance Crypt lies beneath the quarry, to the east. The Serrane punished haste, not clumsiness: if a pillar rings wrong, breathe and read the tablets again.
dlg.orrel.crypt_1.c0: I found a struck-out record in the crypt. The Watch hid it.
dlg.orrel.door_1: You have the Core. The gate stands to the south, beside the Choir waystone. Place it and the resonance curtain will yield.
dlg.orrel.door_1.c0: I found a struck-out record in the crypt. The Watch hid it.
dlg.orrel.end: Orrel's Step breathes again. When you want to see what lies beyond the Choir, the pass will be open. Until then, Mute, rest: you have earned it.
dlg.orrel.end.c0: What do you know of the Watch?
dlg.orrel.final_1: Ildra rests. I can hear the air without her lyric. Thank you, Mute.
dlg.orrel.final_2: They say another Choir can be heard, far to the east. Two Canticles that never went out. If that is true, someone is conducting them. The pass toward the Vesper Mechanism will open when you are ready.
dlg.orrel.final_3: I do not know. Until today I thought I knew who put ours out. (Looks at your hands.) Rest. You have earned it.
dlg.orrel.final_cold: (Stiff.) What I said in the crypt still stands. But Ildra rests, and that… that I owe you. It is not small.
dlg.orrel.final_forgiven: You did what the Watch never dared. And you did not turn your back on me when you could have. (Takes off his gauntlet.) If the Choir ever returns, it will be thanks to people like you. Though you… make no echo.
dlg.orrel.first_1: Halt. …A Mute. Your steps make no echo. (Lowers his spear.) Easy: no one here fears silence. We fear what comes after it.
dlg.orrel.hollow: Emptied singers. They walk, repeat a bar, forget their own name. The Watch says it is a curse of the Taciturn. I say look at how they walk: they follow a score.
dlg.orrel.hub.c2: Why do you call me Mute?
dlg.orrel.hub.c3: What do you need from me?
dlg.orrel.idle: Orrel's Step holds as long as someone keeps watch. Need anything, Mute?
dlg.orrel.idle.c0: I found a struck-out record in the crypt. The Watch hid it.
dlg.orrel.idle.c1: What do you know of the Watch?
dlg.orrel.ildra_1: Ildra sings beneath a shield of voice: damage will not break it, a chord will. Chain three different tones and she will listen. (Lowers his voice.) And Mute… when she falls, stay and hear what she says.
dlg.orrel.ildra_1.c0: I found a struck-out record in the crypt. The Watch hid it.
dlg.orrel.mute: Because you do not resonate. Voice cylinders do not know you and bells do not ring at your step. (A moment of quiet.) Sil, the Taciturn, says it is a gift. I will not argue.
dlg.orrel.place: Orrel's Step. The last inhabited rung of the First Canticle's Lower Terrace. Above, the Choir has been silent for eight centuries. Below, the Hollows.
dlg.orrel.quarry_1: Brannoch charges in a straight line: make him crash into the stone pillars and he will be stunned. And do not fight inside the arc of his hammer.
dlg.orrel.report_1: (Looks you over.) Brannoch has fallen. I can hear the rock breathing. Thank you. I have nothing to pay you with, but take this. (Pause.) There is more. The Bell Gate, to the south, is still sealed: it only yields to the Resonant Core kept in the Quarry Crypt. The Watch ordered me to… never mind. Bring the Core and let Ildra rest.
dlg.orrel.report_1.c1: I will go to the crypt.
dlg.orrel.report_secret: (Looks away.) There are things a warden learns not to ask. If you ever find proof, bring it to me. I would rather hear it from you than discover it myself.
dlg.orrel.task: East, the Quarry. The brass drones have turned on us and a hollow foreman, Brannoch, pounds the rock until the echo bleeds. Go. Use the Quarry Waystone to save the walk. And listen before you step: what hides, sounds.
dlg.orrel.town: Hesk sells what she salvages and tunes what she can; Maeve cooks for all and knows more than she says; and Sil… Sil watches the statues. No one asks why.
dlg.orrel.vigilia: Keepers of the Canticles. We believe the Choir can return if the score is reinterpreted. (Hesitates.) I… believed. I believe.
dlg.scout.r: (Clutches his satchel.) Thank you, thank you! I thought those… things would have me for supper. Take this: I found it on the road. And listen: they say the Quarry sounds different at night.
dlg.sil.first_1.c1: I want to re-attune my talents.
dlg.sil.glyph1: The mouthless statues keep what was left unsaid.
dlg.sil.glyph2: Three. Always three. And a door that is not a door.
dlg.tarn.crypt_1: (A figure rises from the rubble, one leg splinted.) You came from above? …Did Hesk send you? Ah. I thought they had buried me on purpose. The others… did not make it. I kept this: the expedition notes.
dlg.tarn.crypt_1.c0: Let's go. I'll get you out.
dlg.tarn.crypt_1.c1: Give me the notes. I cannot carry you.
dlg.tarn.crypt_left: (Hands them over with trembling hands.) Of course. Of course. Tell Hesk… tell her she did not wait for me in vain.
dlg.tarn.crypt_out: Thank you. I… do not know how to repay you. I will follow you out, slowly. Tell Hesk I am sorry about the compass.
dlg.tarn.town_1: Here I am, with a less reliable leg and a new respect for the forge. If you seek what lies where the footprints end at the wall… three glyphs, the notes say. Ask Sil about the statues.
